text.card: A red giant 4,022 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.92 solar masses and 14.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,528 K at its surface.
